# P5 FL18 alpha-unblocking owner/admin ceremony package

Mission: `P5-CODEX-FINAL-ALPHA-UNBLOCKING-CLOSURE-V1`.

This is the single current engineering package. It supersedes FL17 package self-hash
`f1da80801233be0f7f2080f2596c1cb512a0dd377b75cd58e55809c6d09c9e1f`.
The package is ceremony-ready but entirely unexecuted. Its package self-hash is
reported outside the package to avoid a hash cycle.

## Current and future state

- Current production remains schema 2 and `researchctld` remains active.
- This engineering mission did not deprivilege production k3, install an owner
  anchor, deploy v3, register C/D/root, read real labels, execute T1, or execute
  Wave-1.
- Future owner/admin ceremony order is binding:
  admin recovery -> read-only preflight -> admin transport -> k3 deprivilege and
  root-key removal -> stale-context termination/reboot -> fresh-k3 proof ->
  independent admin/root negative verification -> owner anchor and exact TCB ->
  v2-to-v3 migration -> post-deploy verification -> direct C -> direct D -> root.

## Closed engineering blockers

1. Trust order: no owner anchor or v3 TCB is accepted before deprivilege, reboot,
   fresh-k3 proof, and independent root re-verification.
2. Database model: `researchctld` remains `research-writer`; DB is 0600
   `research-writer:research-writer`; directory is 0750
   `research-writer:research-client`; service UMask is 0077 so newly created
   WAL/SHM bytes are never group-readable. The API socket is explicitly 0660.
3. Complete TCB: exact manifest covers runtime app, migration, wrapper, base unit,
   owner drop-in, Python 3.12, stdlib/dynamic libraries, APSW wheel and extracted
   members. Live wrapper/unit/drop-in hashes are verified before daemon-reload.
4. Root SSH: Match-aware effective root AuthorizedKeysFile paths are resolved;
   exact agent fingerprints are removed; independent allowlisted recovery keys
   are preserved; aliases/symlinks/custom ambiguity fail closed; absence is
   independently reverified before owner trust.
5. Owner ceremony: deterministic tooling materializes C, then D, then exact root;
   late-bound values and an outcome-blind resource policy have no defaults;
   detached signatures use exactly runtime canonical bytes; mutation commands
   require two explicit execution gates.
6. Attestation: final tests use stable IDs and separate suite counts. Package
   identity is non-circular: 10 lists payload; 11 hashes payload plus 10; package
   self is SHA256(11).

## Runtime preconditions (not engineering blockers)

- A human owner/admin must provide independent transport credentials, the owner
  Ed25519 public authority key, an owner signature over the final TCB manifest,
  exact agent fingerprints, and an explicit recovery-key allowlist.
- Cloud IAM/OS Login/metadata regrant paths must be independently neutralized
  when applicable.
- The owner chooses every late-bound identity/time/nonce field and the Wave-1
  resource policy from sealed synthetic benchmark evidence only. No convenience
  default exists and no real label may be read.

## Post-cutover gates

- Exact live TCB and platform hashes pass.
- daemon user/group remain `research-writer:research-client`.
- schema is 3; `researchctl verify` and `rebuild-check` pass.
- authority rows are zero before C.
- fresh k3 cannot use sudo/root groups/root SSH/direct SQLite/live TCB mutation.
- C is APPLIED before D; D is APPLIED before root registration.

## Tests

- shell syntax: 10/10
- static tests: 31/31
- functional fixtures: 15/15 executed, 0 skipped
- targeted security regressions: 28/28

Canonical details and every case ID are in `tests/TEST_COUNTS.json`.

## Status classification

- Engineering blockers before package readiness: zero, subject to final external
  binding-review collection and package-identity verification.
- Owner-ceremony runtime preconditions: credentials, fingerprints/allowlist,
  owner TCB signature, late-bound values, resource policy, explicit execution.
- Post-cutover verification steps: scripts 07 and 08, then C/D/root receipt gates.

`NEXT_ACTION=OWNER_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED` is valid only after the external
freeze report records final package hashes and all binding reviewers are collected.
